idempotent-side-effect.purpose: Prevent duplicate external writes when n8n retries or receives duplicate events.
required_controls: derive a stable idempotency key from the business event
persist/check the key before the side effect
send the key to upstream APIs when they support idempotency headers
record the external resource ID after success

rate-limit-backoff.purpose: Bound retries for transient API failures and rate limits.
required_controls: respect Retry-After when available
cap retry attempts
route terminal failures to the error/dead-letter workflow

human-approval.purpose: Keep destructive or externally visible actions behind an explicit human decision.
required_controls: persist the proposed action and exact arguments
wait for an authenticated approval event
bind approval to the original action/arguments
expire stale approvals
audit approver, timestamp, and final execution ID

dead-letter-error-workflow.purpose: Make terminal automation failures operator-visible and replayable.
required_controls: attach a workflow-level error workflow
capture workflow/execution/node/error metadata
redact credentials and sensitive payload fields
persist a replay reference or business event ID
alert only after retry policy is exhausted
authenticate, verify a signature, or validate a shared secret
apply request size and rate limits
validate required payload fields before side effects
derive a duplicate/idempotency key

observability.purpose: Make workflow behavior diagnosable in production.
required_controls: record n8n execution ID
record business correlation/idempotency ID
measure external call latency and failures
capture side-effect resource IDs
link terminal failures to the dead-letter record

sandboxed-code.purpose: Reduce the blast radius of Code/Function nodes.
required_controls: minimize secrets exposed to the node
validate untrusted inputs
avoid arbitrary outbound destinations
prefer dedicated integration nodes for high-risk side effects
